maria: Quick design check — reordered CTAs for the vectors preview. Current top-right has "Export all" then "Download selected". Thinking we should flip them so primary action is contextually about selection when rows are selected. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

jonathan: I like the idea. When nothing is selected, primary should be "Export all". When selection > 0, primary becomes "Download selected". Keeps hierarchy consistent with intent.

sam: Agree. But need to make the transition obvious for keyboard users — also update focus order. If the primary button swaps, tab order should reflect the current primary.

leo: Right — we should avoid DOM reordering because that can be jarring for screen readers. Instead toggle styles + aria-pressed or aria-live update to convey which action is primary. Example: `aria-live="polite" role="status"` on the selection counter.

aleyna: Quick accessibility nit: when the selection count changes, announce "3 rows selected, Download selected enabled". Also ensure the disabled primary has `aria-disabled="true"` not just `disabled` for consistent screen reader behavior.

maria: Good call. UX question: should the "Download selected" be hidden until any selection exists, or shown but disabled? Which is better for discoverability?

jonathan: Prefer showing it disabled — user learns the feature exists. Hidden controls often confuse people. Maybe add a tooltip on hover: "Select rows to enable".

sam: If we show disabled, ensure contrast and keyboard focus still visible. CSS suggestion: `button[aria-disabled="true"] { opacity: 0.6; box-shadow: none; }` but keep focus outline for keyboard users.

leo: Implementation idea: keep DOM order stable: [Export all] [Download selected], but swap `data-primary="true"` attribute and change classes. Screen reader announcement handled by element with `role=status`. Pseudocode: ```js
function onSelectionChange(n){
 document.querySelector('#sel-status').textContent = `${n} rows selected`;
 document.querySelector('#download-btn').classList.toggle('primary', n>0);
 document.querySelector('#export-btn').classList.toggle('primary', n===0);
}
```

maria: Love that. Copy tweak: instead of "Export all" maybe "Export all vectors" to be explicit. And "Download selected" -> "Download selected vectors" for consistency. Short and clear.

aleyna: Copy preference noted. Accessibility follow-up: tab stop order should be: row checkbox, then row actions, then global toolbar (Export/Download). If toolbar is sticky, ensure `aria-hidden` is not set when off-screen.

jonathan: On mobile narrow screens, we collapse toolbar into a kebab menu. Need to verify selection state persists when menu opens. Also keyboard users should still be able to open menu with Enter/Space.

sam: Design mock updated here: https://redwood.design/links/vec-preview-cta-v2 (screenshot attached). Visible changes: sticky selection bar, counter with `role=status`, Export + Download buttons with dynamic primary styles. :eyes:

ops-bot: Deploy preview build completed for `vec-preview/cta-v2` — staging URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/vec-preview (build 2026-03-22T14:05Z).

leo: I'll run a quick keyboard/a11y smoke test on staging after lunch. Will check NVDA and VoiceOver announcements.

maria: Thanks everyone. Action items: Sam to update mock copy + show disabled state; Leo to test SR/keyboard; Aleyna to write microcopy for tooltip and aria messages; Jonathan to confirm mobile menu behavior. I'll update the PR with the DOM-stable implementation notes. :thumbsup:

jonathan: One more tiny thing — export CSV header should include `vector_id` for downstream mapping. Add that to the export spec.

maria: Noted. Added to the PR description. Closing loop after Leo's a11y pass. :sparkles:
